verdict.rationale: Saved templates or snippets are a fair capability for an email API product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents any template or snippet feature with variables. Drafts (human review before sending) and attachment sending are adjacent features: they are not reusable saved templates and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
